statement: For every positive m and a sufficiently long middle annulus on the T-line, there is a smooth proper connected auxiliary cover over kbar with horizontal ramification indices dividing one fixed odd ell different from p, on whose entire inverse annulus T has an analytic m-th root. This includes p-power m and p=2.
where_proved: sections/D_local_second_stage.tex, D.17; period-lattice partition, banana stable model, integral slope-one character, endpoint estimates and Jacobian multiplication pullback
depends_on: D.15-D.16 analytic conventions and annular-unit facts; supplied R24 Lemma5.1 and Proposition5.2 reconstructed in detail; Baker-Rabinoff2015 Sections4.1-4.2,4.5.2, Proposition6.1 and Corollary6.6
manuscript_passages: 149; manuscript pp.27-31,62v-63; scans56,59-63,126-127; auxiliary local input R24, Sections5-6, pp.12-16
doubtful_reading: No new reading proposed. The proof concerns the supplied typed R24 manuscript, not a palaeographic claim.
notes: Root requested an annotated reconstruction after independent reviews. The Lambda/Lambda^m partition and torsion-free overlap argument provide roots on every sheet. The character is in H1 of the skeleton, with slope exactly1; no inverse period-matrix factor appears. The logarithm/exponential estimate is uniform on each closed middle subannulus and valid for arbitrary m. Only the algebraic cover is over kbar; analytic roots and lifts need not descend. No priority claim is made.

statement: For the fixed rank-one valuation prolongation of D.15, the specified Ksep inside its completion E is contained in H, the closure of the full universal etale function field Ktilde in E; hence H=E.
where_proved: sections/D_local_second_stage.tex, D.18; all-sheet auxiliary pullbacks, horizontal-index closure, proper etale descent, evaluation at the retained H-point and normality of finite Galois subextensions
depends_on: D.15 all-sheet patching, completed-residue-field evaluation and horizontal-index closure; D.16 L_ell subset H; D.17; SGA1 ExposeX Corollary1.8; supplied R24 Section6
manuscript_passages: 149; manuscript pp.27-31,62v-63; scans56,59-63,126-127; auxiliary local input R24, Sections5-6, pp.12-16
notes: The exterior analytic map is not asserted to descend. The proper finite etale cover descends to kbar, and its full composite has horizontal indices dividing ell even after Galois closure. Evaluation uses the specified H-valued point, including its completed-residue-field embedding, not merely its Berkovich image. Normality identifies the produced embedded field with the chosen copy inside E. Root retains the overall R24 certification and assembly.
